feed_summary: View CSAF Summary Schneider Electric is aware of a vulnerability in its EcoStruxure™ Power Build Rapsody product. The EcoStruxure™ Power Build Rapsody is used to enter or import the single line diagram, to get the extensive bill of material of your switchboard, including all devices, connection items, and mounting components. Failure to apply the remediations provided below may risk memory corruption, heap-based buffer overflow, and/or stack-based buffer overflow, which could result in local attackers being able to exploit these issues to potentially execute arbitrary code. The following versions of Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Power Build Rapsody software are affected: EcoStruxure Power Build Rapsody software vers:generic/<=2.9.1.0_FR, 2.9.12.0101_FR, vers:generic/<=2.8.5.0301_ESP, 2.9.
title: Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Power Build Rapsody software
